verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents official Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby SDKs. The Python reference shows concrete SDK capabilities such as cron trigger management and CEL debugging, and a community thread confirms the SDKs exist across languages. missing for 10: in-depth reference evidence for the TypeScript, Go and Ruby SDKs, and evidence of feature parity or completeness across SDKs (one community comment urged getting 'the full sdk spec down').
